---
title: "Runtime and Ratings"
---

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
```

@fig-runtime-rating plots each film's runtime against its IMDb rating. 

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| label: fig-runtime-rating
#| fig-cap: "Runtime against IMDb Rating"
plt.scatter(films["runtime_min"], films["imdb_rating"])
plt.xlabel("Runtime (minutes)")
plt.ylabel("IMDb rating")
plt.show()
```


```{python}
films["decade"] = films["year"] // 10*10
films.groupby("decade")["imdb_rating"].mean()
```
